style: Avant-garde percussive art-rock and electronic kinetic post-punk. Harmony=quartal suspension fields and modal drone roots with shifting bitonal upward blooms. Melody=angular vowel-stretched intervals with ejective k' t' attacks and glottal a'a stops. Rhythm=3:2 cross-rhythm coupling over a motorik pulse with mechanical adding-machine transients. Timbre=additive synth partials, 8-bit pulse waves, DTMF touch-tones, mechanical adding machine, and optigan pads. Performance=relentlessly urgent, nervous, highly kinetic, and mechanically precise. Production=multi-register stem separation with dry close-miked transients and spatial prismatic panned echoes. Dynamic profiling includes sharp gating, micro-silences, tape saturation bursts, resonant feedback loops, and chaotic stereo ping-pongs that mimic malfunctioning digital telecommunications equipment across all channels with pristine clarity, cementing an aesthetic of hyper-detailed structural collapse.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Spoken through walkie-talkie with half-duplex clipping]
Let's distract ourselves from the void!
[Groove starts: 3:2 cross-rhythm motorik pulse with mechanical adding-machine transients]
We are wasting ti'ime!!
While the receipt prints fifty miles of useless proof!
[Whistle-register vocal accent, high register]
Fuck everything l.o.l.!
[Sound palette: ring-modulated source mixed with physical-modeling strings]
We build barricades out of unread emails and expired coupons, stacking cardboard boxes until they touch the popcorn ceiling, engineering monuments to absolute triviality.
Every second spent counting dust motes is a strategic victory against the clock, cementing our glorious irrelevance within the glowing fluorescent prison.
We alphabetize our collection of broken plastic utensils by color spectrum, molecular density, and emotional resonance.
We measure the exact trajectory and velocity a single Cheeto crumb travels when flicked across the greasy linoleum floor with toothpick calipers.

[Chorus]
[Communal infection: choir joins with prenasalized nd/mb attacks]
Distraction is the only architecture left standing in the ruins!
[Gq'et! K't'! Glottal stop punctuation active]
We're burning the minutes just to watch the toxic smoke clear!
Wasting ti'ime!!
[Applause density increases, driving the tempo upward]
Because the present is an emergency we refuse to dial on any telephone!
We lock the heavy doors from the inside and throw away the handle down the garbage disposal, dancing barefoot on shattered lightbulbs because the rhythm demands sacrificial blood.
We paint murals of nonexistent mutated pets on the crumbling drywall using leftover instant coffee and cheap yellow mustard.

[Verse 2]
[VHS head-switching tracking damage: short audio buzz and horizontal timing tear]
[Remembers the future / not the present: narrator recalls next Tuesday's collapse]
Next Tuesday we will bitterly regret this exact sentence, so let's shout it infinitely louder right now into the damp plaster!
[Ejective attack obsessive: k' t' p' marked strictly in delivery]
Wasting ti'ime in a fully controlled demolition of our remaining attention spans!
[Additive synth partials bloom upward with bitonal spacing]
Fuck everything l.o.l.!
We set fire to our own schedule books just to watch the glossy ink curl, laughing hysterically as professional appointments turn into bright orange ash.
We construct elaborate conspiracy theories about why the toaster refuses to brown evenly on both sides, drafting blueprints for anti-appliance uprisings.

[Bridge]
[Finite translation budget spent: voices lock into native phonetic rhythm]
[Intermittent failure: channel drops out for two beats, leaving only dry body percussion]
[Click hocket relay between solo voice and small group]
Ba-click, nd-ing, mb-a!
[Polyharmonic suspension field: upper drones imply a separate chord center]
We forgot why we started running through the corridors, so the frantic running is now the permanent destination!
Our legs move entirely on muscle memory and sheer spite, ignoring the burning lungs and the yawning digital chasm beneath our boots.
Nothing matters when the forward speed is high enough to blur the horizon into a single streak of neon indifference.
We invent new prime numbers just to throw them away because nobody is auditing our chaotic mathematics.

[Chorus]
[Choir possession takes over the harmonic anchor]
Distraction is the only architecture left standing!
Wasting ti'ime!!
[Spring-loaded boing resonance on every major snare hit]
Fuck everything l.o.l.!
We tear down the load-bearing walls and replace them with television static, building a cathedral of pure noise that echoes into empty space.
We auction off our childhood memories to invisible bidders using plastic bottle caps as official currency.

[Outro]
[Perpetual uplift: register expands, spatial width blooms, brightness rises without final cadence]
Distract! Distract! Distract the falling sky!
Wasting ti'ime until the audio codec breaks entirely!
[Extreme time-stretch artifact smears the final vocal into watery metallic resonance]
Fuck everything l.o.l.!
[Final abrupt cut on an unresolved suspension field leaving lingering digital hiss in the left channel]
caption: An avant-garde art-rock assault driven by 3:2 cross-rhythms, ejective consonant attacks, and aggressive vocal hockets. Fusing ring-modulated synthesis, adding-machine transients, and a walkie-talkie transmission aesthetic, the track builds a relentlessly kinetic architecture of distraction. As choruses swell and time-stretch artifacts smear the edges, the performance treats panic and play as simultaneous physical laws, refusing easy resolution for pure ecstatic momentum across every channel.
